Title: Atari Stella Programmer's Guide / TIA Model 1A
Review_scope: Atari text reconstructed in 1993. TIA description, audio control and output pull-down impedance; audio diagram PDF p40 (printed35), write-register map PDF p50 (printed45), clock/write diagrams PDF pp52-53 (printed47-48). The diagrams do not supply a numeric UMC setup/hold table.

Title: Atari PAL Model 2600 Field Service Manual, C018041, Sep.1981 Rev.1
Review_scope: Archived Atari manual; accessible OCR confirms PAL main clock near3.546MHz and PHI0/PHI2 socket checks. Original PDF download was unavailable. Do not treat unreadable/unavailable PAL diagram details as independently verified here.

Title: Best Electronics Atari replacement-chip cross-reference
Review_scope: Supplier's own catalog identifies UM6526P1 with Atari C011903 PAL, and a separate NTSC TIA family. This supports identification, not UMC electrical limits.

Title: Adafruit Si5351A original breakout #2045 and pinout
Review_scope: Manufacturer instructions: supply VIN at MCU logic voltage; I2C has10k pull-ups and level shifting; clock outputs are approximately3V. Selected original board has25-MHz crystal. Product: https://www.adafruit.com/product/2045

Title: TI SN74HCT14, SCLS225G
Review_scope: PDIP-14 pinout p3; threshold/output-level limits p5; maximum propagation40ns and transition19ns at4.5V,50pF p6. RC delay is an application calculation, not a fixed timing specification.

Title: Adafruit Si5351 library public API
Review_scope: Checked APIs: begin(TwoWire*), setupPLLInt, setupMultisynth, setupRdiv, resetPLL, readDeviceStatus and enableOutputs. Firmware uses these APIs but was not compiled.

Title: Atari 2600/2600A domestic service manual
Review_scope: Atari NTSC console interface and pinout reference. Not a PAL/UMC datasheet. TIA audio load is treated as a console-derived design choice, not a guaranteed clone transfer curve.

Title: TI SN74HCT595, SCLS880A
Review_scope: Page 3: pin functions; pages 4-6: levels, setup requirements and propagation delays. Selected package: PW/TSSOP-16.

Title: TI SN74HCT74, SCLS169G
Review_scope: Page 3: pin diagram; pages 4-6: levels, setup/hold and maximum propagation delays. N/PDIP-14.

Title: TI SN74HCT00, SCLS062F
Review_scope: Pin diagram on page 2; electrical specifications and propagation delays on pages 4-5. N/PDIP-14.

Title: TI TUSB320, SLLSEN9F
Review_scope: Page 4: pin functions. Table 7-3 on page 13: OUT1/OUT2 and current advertisement. EN_N tied to GND follows the application example.

Title: TI TPS2552/3, SLVS841F
Review_scope: Pages 5-6: pinout and active polarity. Table 2, page 20: 21.5 kohms gives 1106...1297 mA including 1% resistor tolerance.

Title: TI TLV755P, SBVS320D
Review_scope: Page 3, DBV package only: 1 IN / 2 GND / 3 EN / 4 NC / 5 OUT. Selected part: TLV75533PDBVR.

Title: Pololu S13V15F5, item 4084
Review_scope: Manufacturer connections: VIN/GND/VOUT; output 5 V +/-3%; buck-boost; input 2.8...22 V. Complete module; its internal circuitry is outside this design.

Title: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4
Review_scope: Header pinout and warning to use only one power input. WROOM-32E only, not WROVER.

Title: GCT USB4105 manufacturer drawing
Review_scope: Contact identifiers A1/A4/A5... and B1/B4/B5...; selected part USB4105-GF-A. Connect all shell tabs to GND.

Title: Microchip MCP6001/2/4, DS20001733L, mirrored manufacturer datasheet
Review_scope: Page 1 and Table 3-1 on page 11; MCP6002 PDIP-8. Original manufacturer product page: https://www.microchip.com/en-us/product/MCP6002

Title: Nexperia 2N7002 manufacturer datasheet
Review_scope: Pinning: 1 Gate / 2 Source / 3 Drain. Used only as a slow OE switch at approximately 0.5 mA drain current.

Title: TI LM4808, SNAS051D
Review_scope: Page 2, Figures 1 and 3: external reference, feedback and output capacitors; pages 14-15: component selection. SOIC/VSSOP and WSON pinouts differ.

Title: Neutrik NJ3FP6C manufacturer page
Review_scope: 6.35-mm TRS socket with solder terminals. T/R/S in this design identify functional plug contacts, not asserted solder-lug numbers.

Title: KiCad 9 Schematic Editor, legacy conversion
Review_scope: Legacy section: open the .sch file with its cache library; saving produces .kicad_sch with embedded symbols.

Title: Design assumption / calculation
Review_scope: New wiring, weak termination of unused color pads, RC timing targets and current allowances are engineering choices. They are not asserted as verified UMC specifications.
